'''Torval Fregner''' was a member of the [[Exchange]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]; Fregner and the rest of the Exchange put out a hit on [[Raskurro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] due to his role in blocking the Exchange's organ trafficking expansion.
